subject: Linguagens e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Fruir e apreciar esteticamente diversas manifestações artísticas e culturais, das locais às mundiais, assim como delas participar, de modo a aguçar continuamente a sensibilidade, a imaginação e a criatividade.

components.description_pt: Apreciar expressões artísticas e culturais diversas de contextos locais a globais
components.description_en: Appreciate diverse artistic and cultural expressions from local to global contexts
components.cc_component_description: Identify cultural elements in fables and folktales from diverse traditions

components.description_pt: Responder esteticamente a expressões artísticas de formas que desenvolvam sensibilidade e imaginação
components.description_en: Respond aesthetically to artistic expressions in ways that develop sensitivity and imagination
components.cc_component_description: Compare how a reader's imagination of a text differs from an audio or video version

components.description_pt: Participar ativamente de experiências artísticas e culturais para cultivar criatividade
components.description_en: Participate actively in artistic and cultural experiences to cultivate creativity

components.description_pt: Comparar expressões artísticas e culturais de diferentes contextos para ampliar repertório estético
components.description_en: Compare artistic and cultural expressions from different contexts to broaden aesthetic repertoire
components.cc_component_description: Compare the treatment of similar themes across stories or myths from different cultures

cc_matches.description: Recount stories, including fables and folktales from diverse cultures, and determine their central message, lesson, or moral.

Compare and contrast the experience of reading a story, drama, or poem to listening to or viewing an audio, video, or live version of the text, including contrasting what they "see" and "hear" when reading the text to what they perceive when they listen or watch.

Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.
